mappings.experientialActivity: Make a sound, stop it, change it on piano or drums.
mappings.observableEvidence: The learner makes and stops at least one sound.
mappings.accessibleEquivalent: Large controls; any key or pad works.

mappings.experientialActivity: Hear a note, compare two pitches, hold short and long notes, play C, D, E.
mappings.observableEvidence: Mini-check: chooses the higher of two heard notes; plays C, D, E in order.
mappings.assessment: One listening mini-check marks the concept as explored, not mastered.
mappings.accessibleEquivalent: Show-the-notes option lights the keys; this is not the same as hearing pitch and says so.

mappings.experientialActivity: Tap a steady beat, hear a rhythm over it, build a 4-beat rhythm with a rest, see it written in 4/4.
mappings.observableEvidence: Mini-check: picks which of two heard rhythms has a silent beat; builds a rhythm with sounds and a rest.
mappings.assessment: One listening mini-check marks the concept as explored. Taps are not timed or marked.
mappings.accessibleEquivalent: Beats light up as they sound; patterns are also shown as shapes with words.

mappings.experientialActivity: Play along with a steady pulse.
mappings.observableEvidence: Taps on the beat, compared with the expected events.
mappings.assessment: Practice, then on-your-own pattern; timing described.

mappings.experientialActivity: Keep counting through a one-beat rest.
mappings.observableEvidence: Silence on the rest beat, compared with the expected events.
mappings.accessibleEquivalent: Counting shown; rests drawn as shapes with words.

mappings.experientialActivity: One crotchet or two even quavers per beat in a 4/4 exercise.
mappings.observableEvidence: Matches the written pattern of crotchets and quavers.

mappings.experientialActivity: Listen and play notes that rise and fall.
mappings.observableEvidence: Plays notes in the heard order.

mappings.experientialActivity: Find C, D and E and play a short pattern.
mappings.observableEvidence: Plays the right keys in order.

mappings.experientialActivity: Read C, D, E on the treble stave and play the keys.
mappings.observableEvidence: Plays the written notes.
mappings.accessibleEquivalent: Note names on keys and stave.
mappings.confidence: proposed-weak: reading notation is not named in the F-4 descriptors

mappings.experientialActivity: Play C to G up and down.
mappings.observableEvidence: Plays five notes in order.

mappings.experientialActivity: Hear and play C and C♯; meet the name D♭.
mappings.observableEvidence: Mini-check: chooses the higher of C and C♯ by listening.
mappings.assessment: One listening mini-check marks the concept as explored.

mappings.experientialActivity: Play one-beat and two-beat notes in 4/4.
mappings.observableEvidence: Holds notes for the written length.

mappings.experientialActivity: Read and play a two-bar melody with rests.
mappings.observableEvidence: Plays the written notes and rests.
mappings.confidence: proposed-weak: 6C01 is about notating compositions, used here only as related reading

mappings.experientialActivity: Compare steps and skips.
mappings.observableEvidence: Plays step and skip patterns.

mappings.experientialActivity: Read and play a simple lower melody in bass clef.
mappings.observableEvidence: Plays the written low notes.

mappings.experientialActivity: Bass drum on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4.
mappings.observableEvidence: Plays the groove; which drum was hit is not judged by microphone.
mappings.accessibleEquivalent: Pads or kit view, slower tempo.

mappings.experientialActivity: Steady quavers on hi-hat with snare on 2 and 4.
mappings.observableEvidence: Plays the pattern.

mappings.experientialActivity: Tom pattern ending on a crash.
mappings.observableEvidence: Plays the fill.

mappings.experientialActivity: Make a musical reply to a short phrase.
mappings.observableEvidence: A saved reply the learner made.

mappings.experientialActivity: Tell a story with loud and soft sounds.
mappings.observableEvidence: A saved sound story; optional sharing chosen by the learner.

mappings.experientialActivity: Hear a rhythm and create an answer.
mappings.observableEvidence: A saved answer rhythm.

mappings.experientialActivity: Reply to a melody, higher or lower.
mappings.observableEvidence: A saved melodic reply and the learner’s choice.

mappings.experientialActivity: Make A and B sections and arrange them.
mappings.observableEvidence: Saved sections and the order chosen.

mappings.experientialActivity: Add a second part and decide how it changes the piece.
mappings.observableEvidence: Saved two-part piece and the learner’s reason.

gaps: Exploring and responding (E01, E02) has no Carmen activity in any band: no listening to music from other cultures, times and places yet.
E02 (First Nations Australians) needs authorised material and cultural advice; Carmen will not invent or imitate it.
Presenting and performing is only informal playing on the device; sharing with an audience is optional and outside the app.
Singing is not covered (keyboard and drums only).
Foundation descriptors are Arts-wide; Carmen covers only the music part of D01 and C01.
No mapping is checked by a primary music educator yet.
